titleZh: 分享背景 · 横版左右内容空间
spec: Create a LANDSCAPE 1536 x 1024 background, exactly 3:2, for placing two independently rendered card/content faces side by side later. Keep BOTH left and right main areas quiet and pale cool blue: left x=7%..47%, right x=53%..93%, both y=12%..82%. They are low-detail atmospheric spaces, NOT pre-drawn panels or frames. Keep dark blue-violet city architecture and flecked paint concentrated along the far outer left/right edges and lower corners. The middle divider should be only a very subtle distant cyan architectural rhythm, with no strong dark tower. Leave a shallow quiet strip along the lower middle for later dimension information. Avoid a conspicuous horizon crossing either content area. Maintain visible painted-city identity and a little warm-window/magenta interest at the perimeter.

Avoid photorealism, smooth 3D, pastel stationery, generic gradient-only backgrounds and muddy blurred forms. No people, animals, mascots, letters, numbers, title, wordmark, readable code, logos, watermark, QR, text placeholders, card outlines, layout guides or embedded content blocks. Tiny building lights stay attached to buildings. Decorative holographic scenery, when present, stays near building edges and contains abstract line/block geometry with NO readable glyphs.
